Что такое «гантельки» и как они начисляю: What “dumbbells” are and how they are earned
Гантельки — это бонусная система внутри: Dumbbells are a bonus system within workouts. You earn them for working correctly in the gym: either for strength performance or for maintaining the right intensity in cardio.
В силовых залах гантельки начисляются за: In strength gyms, dumbbells are awarded for completing exercises. After each set, you need to enter on the tablet the weight you worked with and rate how hard the exercise felt.
Например, если вы сделали ягодичный мост: For example, if you did a glute bridge with 35 kg, you enter that weight and choose how it felt — easy, normal, or hard. Based on this, the system adjusts its weight recommendations: if it was easy, it will suggest increasing the weight; if hard, it will correct it.
За такие действия вы получаете гантельки: For these actions you receive dumbbells — usually 1 to 4 per set. At the end of the workout, the screens show how many dumbbells you earned.
В зале Bootcamp гантельки начисляются за: In the Bootcamp gym, dumbbells are awarded for staying in the required intensity zone.
Самая эффективная зона — это оранжевая (: The most effective zone is orange (roughly 80–90% of maximum load). This is where fat burning is at its best.
Если вы уходите выше 90% — это уже красн: If you go above 90%, that's the red zone, where the load is too high. Below 80% is the yellow zone, where effectiveness is lower. There are also lower zones where the load is minimal.
Во время тренировки на экранах отображаю: During the workout, the zones are displayed on the screens, and at the end you see how much time you spent in each. A leaderboard is also formed — it features those who held the effective (orange) zone the longest.
Гантельки в кардио начисляются в зависим: In cardio, dumbbells are awarded depending on the zone:
оранжевая зона — примерно 1 гантелька в: orange zone — about 1 dumbbell per minute

Metcon — новая механика начисления ганте: Metcon — the new dumbbell-earning mechanic (how dumbbells are earned in Metcon)
Metcon — это интервальная кардиотрениров: Metcon is an interval cardio workout, so here dumbbells are awarded not just for time spent in a high heart-rate zone, but for the quality of each interval.
Раньше система учитывала только время, п: Previously, the system only counted time spent in the high heart-rate zone. The longer the athlete held a high heart rate, the more dumbbells they received.
Теперь оценивается качество интервальной: Now the quality of interval work is evaluated. What matters is not just staying in the high zone for a long time, but performing each cycle correctly:
Во время активной фазы необходимо быстро: During the active phase, you need to quickly raise your heart rate to working intensity, and during rest, let it come down. The more clearly these cycles repeat throughout the workout, the higher the final score.
Тренировка Metcon состоит из 32 рабочих: A Metcon workout consists of 32 work intervals (8 rounds of 4 sets).
Каждый из 32 подходов система оценивает: The system evaluates each of the 32 sets by several criteria:
достиг ли атлет рабочей пульсовой зоны (: whether the athlete reached the working heart-rate zone (orange zone and above);
насколько быстро разогнался пульс во вре: how quickly the heart rate rose during work;
насколько хорошо пульс восстановился во: how well the heart rate recovered during rest;
насколько сбалансированы усилие и восста: how balanced effort and recovery are.
После этого рассчитывается средняя оценк: After that, the average score of all 32 intervals is calculated, and this is what determines the number of dumbbells earned.
Больше гантелек получат атлеты, которые:: More dumbbells will go to athletes who:
быстро разгоняют пульс во время работы;: quickly raise their heart rate during work;
позволяют пульсу снижаться во время отды: let their heart rate come down during rest;
поддерживают такой ритм на протяжении вс: maintain this rhythm throughout the entire workout.
Меньше гантелек будут получать те, кто д: Fewer dumbbells will go to those who keep a constantly high heart rate without clear “work — recovery” cycles.
В Metcon отдых — такая же важная часть т: In Metcon, rest is just as important a part of the workout as work.
Не нужно стараться всё время удерживать: You don't need to try to hold a high heart rate the whole time. On the contrary, the system rewards those who:
максимально выкладывается в рабочей фазе: give their maximum in the work phase;
повторяет этот цикл на протяжении всей т: repeat this cycle throughout the entire workout.
Чем качественнее интервалы, тем выше ито: The better the quality of the intervals, the higher the final score and the more dumbbells are awarded.
Важно: На данный момент новая механика д: Important: At the moment, the new mechanic works only in the Metcon gym. For Bootcamp, it is under development and will be introduced later. For now, the changes affect only the number of dumbbells and leaderboard position, and later they will also directly affect Hero Points.

Что такое «Hero Points» и как их получит: What “Hero Points” are and how to earn them
Hero Points — это очки, которые вы получ: Hero Points are points you receive for every workout. They show how well you completed it and are used to display your progress and leaderboard position.
Очки начисляются не только за факт посещ: Points are awarded not only for attendance, but also for the quality of performance.
В силовых тренировках количество очков з: In strength workouts, the number of points depends on how closely you follow the recommended weights. The closer you are to the system's recommendations, the more points you get.
В кардио и других тренировках сейчас дей: In cardio and other workouts, a fixed system currently applies: a set number of points is awarded for attendance and additional points for using a heart rate monitor.
Также учитывается качество выполнения уп: The quality of exercise performance is also taken into account — in the app it is shown as a percentage. The higher the percentage, the higher the final number of points for the workout.
После занятия в приложении можно посмотр: After the session, you can view a detailed breakdown in the app: exactly what the points were awarded for.
За пульсометр – 20 баллов, за посещение: 20 points for the heart rate monitor, 30 points for attendance. The remaining 50 depend on following the recommended weights.
Hero Points позволяют отслеживать свой п: Hero Points let you track your progress and compare results within the system. They don't require any extra actions — just train and follow the recommendations. What is Endgame? Endgame is the final point of character growth. To take part in Endgame, the athlete must accumulate 20,000 character growth points.
Чем отличаются Hero Points и гантельки?: What's the difference between Hero Points and dumbbells?
🏋️ Гантельки — начисляются за качество к: 🏋️ Dumbbells are awarded for the quality of a specific workout. Their number depends on correct exercise execution, working weights, or working in the target heart-rate zone (depending on the workout format).
⭐ Hero Points — это очки общего прогресс: ⭐ Hero Points are the athlete's overall progress points in Hero's Journey. They reflect the athlete's development and activity in the system, not the result of a single workout.
Endgame — это финальная цель пути спортс: Endgame is the ultimate goal of the athlete's journey in Hero's Journey and the maximum level of character development. To reach Endgame, you need to accumulate 20,000 character growth points (XP). However, Endgame is not just a certain number of points or visits. It symbolizes the path the athlete travels: discipline, consistency, the drive to become better, and the readiness to overcome oneself. Every workout, completed task, and achieved goal gradually brings the client closer to this milestone, turning the training process into a true hero's journey. The administrator's task is to help the client understand that the growth system exists not just for the numbers, but to make progress visible, keep motivation up, and show how far the person has come on their path. If a client asks what happens after reaching Endgame, it's important to explain that it is not the end of training, but a symbol of completing one major stage of development. Having reached the maximum character level, the athlete keeps training, sets new goals, and keeps improving — because real growth doesn't end with achieving Endgame.
После достижения Endgame путешествие не: After reaching Endgame, the journey doesn't end — it moves to a new level. Питание — это раздел приложения Hero's J: Nutrition is a section of the Hero's Journey app that helps the user control their daily diet and stick to their goal. Based on profile data and the completed assessment, the app calculates an individual daily norm of calories and macronutrients (proteins, fats, and carbohydrates). Throughout the day, the app shows how many calories and macros are left until the daily norm is met, and also displays a meal plan with the distribution of meals. When the user's parameters or goal change, the app suggests retaking the assessment to update the recommendations. In addition to nutrition control, the section includes a water intake tracker where you can quickly log water and other drinks, track your daily fluid norm, and get useful tips on maintaining water balance.
